items.title: Ernest 'Punch' Miller Interview, 1960-04-04
items.q: I played with him with the Royal American show. Eddie Carl, trauma player, good old, good musician, man.

ctx.x: Well, who was Ed Carnes? Did you ever know Ed Carnes? Ed Carnes or Carnes or something like that?
Well, I know I played, Tramon played with Eddie Carl.
